name: TouchStar TS3300
summary: The TouchStar TS3300 is an Ex ec ic 7-inch Android tablet from TouchStar, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android (version not published).

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T5 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T105°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 1 (2025-05-13), checked 2026-10-25. ATEX certification unconfirmed.

iecex.marking: Ex ec ic IIC T5 Gc / Ex ic IIIC T105°C Dc

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: do not attach the equipment to the charging cradle in a hazardous area; charge only via the cradle supplied by the manufacturer (Um 12 V d.c.); battery charging only at +10 °C to +45 °C.
safety.peripherals: Charging cradle only in the non-hazardous area; the certificate describes a micro-SD card and SIM socket but their use in the Ex area is not stated in the text read.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Cradle with magnetic one-handed insertion (non-hazardous area only; vehicle mounting). Optional EM3080W-V2 barcode imager.

specs.display: 7-inch Colour TFT IPS, anti-glare, high-impact polycarbonate touchscreen
specs.chip: Qualcomm octa-core (Kryo Gold quad 2.2 GHz + Kryo Silver quad 1.843 GHz)
specs.frontCamera: Front camera (solid state) named in the IECEx description
specs.ports: MicroSD; SIM socket; USB OTG via cradle interface
specs.docking: Rugged cradle (HGV, van, forklift mounting; magnetic one-handed insertion, locking)
specs.exIp: IP54 (stated in the IECEx EMT 22.0002X equipment description, not in the marking)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (10 MP rear camera; front-facing camera named in the certificate)

unconfirmed.certification.atex.marking: Only an IECEx certificate is published. The ATEX marking is from TouchStar's datasheet.
unconfirmed.certification.iecex.marking: Only an IECEx certificate is published. The ATEX marking is from TouchStar's datasheet.
unconfirmed.os.version: From a single or secondary source; the maker doesn't state it for this model.
unconfirmed.os.atLaunch: From a single or secondary source; the maker doesn't state it for this model.
unconfirmed.os.edition: The maker doesn't state the edition year.

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T5 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 100 °C
No published end date for security updates
